thread:
Priya (CS): FYI: Orion (trial) requests a scaled demo with execs next Friday. They flagged renewal discussion in 45 days. Asking for a reproducible pre-demo checklist we can hand them that covers caching, batching, streaming, and a tiny feedback form for execs. Can we assemble a one-pager?
Liam (SRE): I can draft an ops one-pager. Need a few inputs: expected concurrency, typical prompt size, and whether embedding backfills run during demo windows.
Sam (Customer): They typically run 40 concurrent demo users, prompts ~90 tokens, and nightly embedding backfill at 03:00 local (can shift if needed). We'll avoid heavy jobs during the demo if recommended.
Nora (Solutions Eng): For streaming-heavy short-turn conversations: recommended defaults for demos -> streaming.flush_ms=45, batching.target_tokens=7, batching.max_wait_ms=30. Also set KV prefix cache and prefill common openings.
Liam (SRE): Short curl to prime prefixes (run 8 minutes before demo):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prime \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-small","prompts":["Hi","Show my report","How do I invite a teammate?"]}'
```
This warms the KV cache and reduces cold-path hits.
Priya (CS): Great. For the customer-facing one-pager let's keep it 6 bullets max and a 2-question exec survey. Draft bullets: 1) Run prime script 8m before start; 2) Set streaming.flush_ms=45; 3) Set batching.target_tokens=7 or max_wait_ms=30; 4) Autoscale spike +30% from -5m to +20m; 5) Shift embedding backfill +1h if possible; 6) Enable 1% sample of outputs for hallucination review.
Nora (Solutions Eng): Add a note about fallback: if GPU pool saturates, route to cpu-quantized fallback (expect latency ~1.6x). Put that in the expectations section so execs aren't surprised.
Liam (SRE): Health gating for renewal signal: CS to mark health green if 99th %ile < 240ms across the demo window and error rate < 0.4% for two demos within 14 days. Otherwise set amber and schedule SE follow-up.
OpsBot: Reminder created: "Orion demo prime" at 2026-04-10T09:52:00Z (owner: Priya).
Sam (Customer): Can you also include a tiny feedback form I can pass to execs? Keep it 2 items.
Priya (CS): Draft exec survey: Q1: Perceived responsiveness (1-5). Q2: Any incorrect/confusing outputs? (Yes/No + short note). We'll request a screenshot of the Console latency tile for the demo route.
Nora (Solutions Eng): I'll attach a 1-click prime script link and a short runbook snippet for their ops (how to undo autoscale changes and verify KV cache).
Liam (SRE): I'll set the autoscale window and add a lightweight failing-open healthcheck that returns cached responses to avoid full demo outage. Will also make a small infra ticket and link it here.
Priya (CS): Action owners: Priya -> customer-facing one-pager + survey; Liam -> infra ticket + autoscale + healthcheck; Nora -> prime link + runbook snippet; Sam -> confirm backfill shift. Can we confirm by EOD?
Liam (SRE): Confirmed. Ticket will be posted once infra window approved.
Nora (Solutions Eng): Confirmed, will post the 1-click script and runbook link here.
Priya (CS): Thanks team. We'll collect post-demo feedback and update the runbook based on latency and hallucination notes.
